title: Smoothed estimation of Wasserstein barycenters
summary: This paper studies the statistical estimation of exact Wasserstein barycenters. Existing non-asymptotic results for empirical barycenters exhibit a severe curse of dimensionality. Motivated by the semi-dual formulation of the barycenter problem and its associated Sobolev optimization geometry, we develop a smoothness-aware approach that combines density estimation with Sobolev geometric structure to estimate the population barycenter.
